# Concrete Toronto

> Concrete Toronto is a concrete contractor serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area: concrete driveways, patios, walkways, sidewalks, porches, steps, foundations, slabs, repair, replacement and parging.

Local crew with 15 years of experience and hundreds of concrete jobs completed in Toronto and surrounding areas, residential and commercial. Every job carries a 2-year warranty and a satisfaction guarantee, and crews stick to the agreed schedule. Call (416) 489-4898 or request a quote through the online form.

## Main
- [Concrete Toronto, home](https://concrete-toronto.ca/): Concrete contractor in Toronto for driveways, patios, walkways and anything concrete. Free quote form, service list, process, FAQ.
- [All services](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/): The full list of concrete and parging services in one place.
- [Service areas](https://concrete-toronto.ca/locations/): Toronto, Scarborough, Markham, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, North York, Pickering, Oshawa, Ajax, Whitby and the entire GTA.
- [About](https://concrete-toronto.ca/about/): 15 years of residential and commercial concrete experience.

## Concrete installation
- [Concrete Driveways](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-driveways/): New driveways and full replacements on a compacted base.
- [Concrete Patios](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-patios/): Level backyard patios finished to shed water.
- [Concrete Walkways](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-walkways/): Front and side walkways with a slip-resistant finish.
- [Concrete Sidewalks](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-sidewalks/): Safe, even sidewalks for homes and businesses.
- [Concrete Porches](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-porches/): Porch repairs, resurfacing and new pours.
- [Concrete Steps](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-steps/): Solid, even front and back steps.
- [Concrete Foundations](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-foundations/): Residential and commercial foundation work.
- [Concrete Slabs](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-slabs/): Garage, shed and addition slabs.

## Repair and restoration
- [Concrete Repair](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-repair/): Crack and surface repairs that restore existing concrete.
- [Concrete Replacement](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/concrete-replacement/): Removal of old surfaces and fresh new pours.
- [Parging Services](https://concrete-toronto.ca/services/parging/): Parge coats for foundation walls and basements.
